title: Utility Line Protection Plans: Contractor Workmanship Chargeback on Exterior Line Recalls
content:
# Contractor Workmanship Chargeback on Exterior Line Recalls

Network Management chargeback standard, Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans, exterior service lines.

## Rule

A repaired exterior section that fails again inside the repair guarantee is charged back to the network contractor who repaired it, and the recovered share returns to the exterior permanent-work payment. Exterior workmanship recovery: for a recall reported no more than the exterior full recovery days after the completed repair it recalls was completed, the exterior full recovery share of the payment on the authorization that completion closed is added, where that authorization is a section repair (a completed authorization is never reversed, so its payment stands as authorized); for a recall reported later than the exterior full recovery days but no later than the plan's repair guarantee days after that completion, the exterior half recovery share of that section repair payment is added; for every other request nothing is added. The exterior workmanship recovery is paid on top of the occurrence cap, and only for permanent exterior work whose contractor quote is above the exterior permanent-work payment.

## Figures

- Exterior full recovery days: 90 calendar days.
- Repair guarantee: 180 calendar days on every Utility Line Protection Plan.
- Exterior full recovery share: 1 (the whole of the section repair payment).
- Exterior half recovery share: 0.5 (half of it).

## Ladder

| Recall reported, in calendar days after the recalled repair was completed | Amount added |
|---|---|
| on or before day 90 | 1 times the payment on the section repair authorization that completion closed |
| day 91 through day 180 | 0.5 times that section repair payment |
| any other request, a new failure included | nothing |

## Reading the records

- The recalled repair is the most recent completed repair on the same line. Its completion entry in the claim history names the authorization it closed, by authorization number.
- The share is taken of the payment on that one authorization, where it is a section repair. A completed authorization is never reversed, so its payment is read as it was authorized.

## Boundary cases

- Recall on day 90: the full share. Recall on day 91: the half share.
- Recall on day 180: the half share. Day 181 is outside the repair guarantee: nothing is added.
- A new failure, not a recall: nothing is added.

## Hypothetical examples

- The completion closed a section repair authorization paying $800.00; recall on day 60: $800.00 is added.
- The same, recall on day 120: half of $800.00, $400.00, is added.
